model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates model accuracy percentages across three evaluation categories, comparing multiple training methods with and without self-reflection. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics” in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62 with tick marks every 2 percentage points. Each category shows six adjacent bars (grouped side-by-side) corresponding to the legend entries: DAPO (light blue with diagonal hatching), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), SRPO (solid salmon), GRPO (orange with diagonal hatching), PPO (teal with diagonal hatching), and PPO+Self-reflection (solid green). For Mathverse, the bars are approximately DAPO 53.1%, DAPO+Self-reflection 56.1%, SRPO 55.8%, GRPO 53.4%, PPO 53.3%, and PPO+Self-reflection 54.5%. For MMLU, the bars are approximately DAPO 55.9%, DAPO+Self-reflection 56.9%, SRPO 57.1%, GRPO 55.8%, PPO 54.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection 56.2%. For Physics, the bars are approximately DAPO 57.5%, DAPO+Self-reflection 61.0%, SRPO 60.6%, GRPO 58.1%, PPO 56.9%, and PPO+Self-reflection 59.1%. The bars are not presented in a sorted order by height; instead, they follow the fixed method order indicated by the legend, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and hatching patterns.

For MMLU, the grouped bars are approximately DAPO 55.9%, DAPO+Self-reflection 56.9%, GRPO 55.8%, SRPO 57.1%, PPO 54.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection 56.2%. For Physics, the grouped bars are approximately DAPO 57.5%, DAPO+Self-reflection 61.0%, GRPO 58.1%, SRPO 60.6%, PPO 56.9%, and PPO+Self-reflection 59.1%.
